records.text: Denni'ka is a butcher in Stonetalon Mountains. Her shop offers ordinary goods, and her terse greeting asks what a customer wants.
A Venture Co. Operator is one of the company's operators associated with its Super Reaper 6000 woodcutting machine. The machine's blueprints are identified as obtainable from an operator.

A Venture Co. logger working in Windshear Crag, this goblin belongs to the company cutting trees in Stonetalon. Both Gaxim Rustfizzle and Seereth Stonebreak target Venture Co. Loggers in quests opposing the company's operation.

A Venture Co. deforester working in Windshear Crag, this goblin belongs to the company cutting trees in Stonetalon. Gaxim Rustfizzle's quest targets Venture Co. Deforesters alongside Loggers in an effort to hinder the company's operation.
A Venture Co. engineer found at Windshear Crag.
A Venture Co. machine smith found at Windshear Crag.

Keeper Albagorm is a protector of the forest spirits, alarmed by the destruction of the Charred Vale and the Bloodfury harpies blocking efforts to restore it. He charges visitors with driving the harpies out, then asks them to carry word of the forest's need for aid to the druid Falfindel Waywarder. His concern is the land's recovery, which he sees as work that can begin once the harpies are subdued.

Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is an old friend of Darsok and remembers Rokhan's role in an earlier fight against the Bloodfeathers. At Malaka'jin, he proposes a cruel scheme for three captured elves: a concoction he calls forest magic, made from animal parts. His gleeful talk of cages and brewing, followed by mocking laughter as he works, shows a deliberate, taunting attitude toward the captives and nature. He is pleased to hear the Bloodfeathers are dead, recalling the old conflict without claiming knowledge beyond what Darsok's letter reports.
A Windshear Digger is identified by its digging role and Windshear name. Smoky Iron Ingots required by the Brutal Armor quest are among its loot.
Windshear Geomancers practice geomancy.
Windshear Overlords investigate suspicious sounds and react angrily to Piznik’s presence, saying he should not have been allowed to remain.
Deepmoss Creepers are spiders that raid Malaka’Jin’s camps at night to steal the trolls’ hunted food, according to Xen’zilla. They use Poison in combat.
Deepmoss Webspinners are web-spinning beasts found across several areas.
Deepmoss Venomspitters are spiders that Xen’zilla identifies among the beasts raiding Malaka’Jin’s camps at night to steal hunted food.
Cliff Stormers are beasts found across several areas.
Raging Cliff Stormers are beasts found across several areas.
A young Pridewing beast found around Stonetalon Peak. It is hostile and uses poison when fighting.
A Pridewing wyvern, larger and more experienced than the young Pridewings. It is hostile and uses a combat spell against its opponents.
A Pridewing skyhunter found across the Stonetalon Peak area. This hostile beast uses a combat spell against its opponents.
A Pridewing consort, encountered among the Pridewings of Stonetalon Peak. It is hostile and casts a spell when badly wounded.
The Pridewing patriarch is an especially formidable member of the Pridewing population. This hostile beast is an elite combatant.
A Fey Dragon found in Stonetalon Peak. This dragon uses Nullify Mana against nearby opponents.
A Wily Fey Dragon found in Stonetalon Peak. This dragon casts a spell when wounded, setting it apart from the Fey Dragon's nearby-range Nullify Mana attack.
Antlered Coursers are common woodland animals found around the Charred Vale and its neighboring Stonetalon areas. They defend themselves with a rushing charge when attacked.
Great Coursers are larger, less numerous relatives of the antlered coursers, found in the Stonetalon area around the Charred Vale. They answer danger with a rushing charge.
Sap Beasts are hostile creatures of the Charred Vale and nearby Stonetalon areas. They respond to an aggressor with a spell.
Corrosive Sap Beasts are found among the Bloodfury territory around the Charred Vale. They use corrosive poison against nearby threats.

Bloodfury Harpies are part of the harpy presence in Stonetalon's Charred Vale. Keepers and tauren in the region regard the encroaching Bloodfuries as a threat to passage and the surrounding life, and ask travelers to cull them; these harpies are among the targets.

Bloodfury Roguefeathers are one of the harpy groups in Stonetalon's Charred Vale. Keepers and tauren in the region seek to cull the Bloodfuries for encroaching on the land and obstructing passage; Roguefeathers are among the targets. In combat, they use a thrashing attack.

A Bloodfury harpy serving as a Slayer in the Charred Vale, this combatant is one of the harpies Keeper Albagorm asks travelers to drive out so the forest can begin to recover. It fights with a curse of recklessness.
A Bloodfury harpy serving as an Ambusher in the Charred Vale, this combatant is among those Keeper Albagorm wants driven out to clear the way for forest regrowth. It attacks with Shock.
A Bloodfury harpy called a Windcaller, found in the Charred Vale. It uses Enveloping Winds when fighting.
A Bloodfury harpy called a Storm Witch, found in the Charred Vale. It attacks with Lightning Bolt.
A Charred Ancient found in the Charred Vale, this creature reacts to an attacker with a hostile spell. Its name and role distinguish it from the nearby Blackened and Vengeful Ancients.
A Blackened Ancient found in the Charred Vale.
A Vengeful Ancient found in the Charred Vale, it is a powerful individual that casts Curse of Thorns on nearby opponents. Its name sets it apart from the Charred and Blackened Ancients.
A fledgling chimaera, a young beast recorded among the wild creatures of this region.
An enraged stone spirit, an elemental creature recorded in this region.
A furious stone spirit, an elemental creature found in this region. In combat it can use Knockdown.
A rogue flame spirit, an elemental creature found across this region. It casts a spell when it draws aggro and can cast another when its health falls between 30 and 60 percent.
A burning ravager, an elemental creature found in this region. It casts a spell when it draws aggro.
A burning destroyer, an elemental creature found in this region. It can cast a spell while it is fighting.
A scorched basilisk, a beast found in this region. In combat it can cast Crystalline Slumber.
A basilisk found in the Stonetalon Mountains. It can cast Crystalline Slumber when attacked.
A basilisk found across parts of the Stonetalon Mountains. It can cast Crystalline Slumber when attacked.
A Cenarion caretaker in the Stonetalon Mountains offers quest interaction. It uses hostile spells when attacked.
A Cenarion botanist found in the Stonetalon Mountains. Braelyn Firehand's quest names botanists among its targets; its description reflects her hostility toward Cenarius's followers.
A Cenarion druid in the Stonetalon Mountains with questgiver interaction. It casts a hostile spell when attacked.
One of the Daughters of Cenarius in the Stonetalon Mountains, named as a target in Braelyn Firehand's quest against Cenarius's followers. It can throw weapons in combat.
Mirkfallon Keeper is a humanoid found in the Stonetalon Mountains. It casts a spell when it enters combat.
Sons of Cenarius are targets in the quest Cenarius’ Legacy, whose text asks for four of them to be killed. This humanoid is found in Stonetalon Mountains and can cast Summon Treant Ally.
Mirkfallon Dryad is a humanoid found in the Stonetalon Mountains. It casts spells on entering combat and while fighting.
Nal’taszar is a dragonkin in the Stonetalon Mountains. It casts spells during combat, including one triggered as its health falls into the 20–40% range.
Twilight Runner is a beast found in the Stonetalon Mountains. It can cast a spell as its health falls within the 20–80% range.
Venture Co. Builder is a humanoid found in the Stonetalon Mountains. Its name identifies it as a builder associated with the Venture Company; it casts a spell in combat.
A humanoid prisoner of Jin'Zil in the Stonetalon Mountains.

XT:4 is a mechanical shredder at Windshear Crag, one of the man-shaped machines felling trees at great speed. Seereth Stonebreak identifies it as a threat to the forest and calls for the shredders to be stopped.

XT:9 is a mechanical shredder at Windshear Crag, one of the man-shaped machines felling trees at great speed. Seereth Stonebreak identifies it as a threat to the forest and calls for the shredders to be stopped.

Gaxim Rustfizzle is a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. He wants to show the night elves how magic, alchemy and engineering can help save their forests. He designs explosives and distractions to disrupt Venture Co. logging while sending others to retrieve its plans and letters.

Kaela Shadowspear is a Sentinel from Ashenvale working with Gaxim in the Charred Vale. She sees the Venture Company's retreat as harm to the land: its weapons scarred the Vale, while fire spirits and corrupted treants threaten it. She gathers samples for Gaxim's investigation and wants the Vale cleared so the land may again know Elune's favor. She misses Sentinel Thenysil and speaks of her with pride.
Grawnal is a general-goods merchant in the Stonetalon region. He is one of the area’s practical supply stops for travelers.

Jeeda is an apprentice witch doctor who also sells reagents in the Stonetalon region. Her title marks her as a practitioner still learning the craft, while her merchant service offers a practical source of supplies.
Chylina is a general-supplies merchant in the Stonetalon region. Her services include ammunition and food, making her a source of everyday provisions as well as general goods.
Nizzik is identified as a Venture armor salesman. He offers goods and repair service, combining equipment sales with practical maintenance for travelers in the Stonetalon region.
Veenix is a Venture Co. merchant in the Stonetalon Mountains who sells goods and repairs equipment.
Illyanie is a cloth armor merchant who offers goods for sale. Her recorded services support a practical role in the local community.

Ken'zigla prepared a healing draught for the wounded Dogran and explains how it should be given to him in two halves, with a night between doses. Ken’zigla arranged for it to be carried to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.

Braelyn Firehand is a magic-seeking agent working for a master who sent her to Stonetalon Peak. She hates the kaldorei druids, whom she sees as obstructing the flow of magic, and recruits help against them. She says she once knew Ordanus and seeks his death after he escaped her grasp. Her account of the Talon Den's hidden caches rests on details she extracted from a druid; she directs others to use them to reach its hoard.

Ziz Fizziks is a gnome engineer who was expelled from the Venture Company after it hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. He sought work through Sputtervalve and now hopes to prove his usefulness to the new employer, though he calls Sputtervalve a cruel taskmaster. Ziz is eager to impress him, values his own engineering talent, and speaks with resentment and mockery about Gerenzo and gnomish engineering choices. His work includes acquiring Venture Company plans and passing along company information; he hopes for a place in a Tinkers’ Union workshop.
Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle is a named combatant.

Piznik is a Venture Co. miner who was demoted from a senior post after Gerenzo took over and sent him into the mines. He secretly gathers information for his former boss, Ziz Fizziks, while mining Gerenzo's gold-green ore. Extracting a sample requires protection from patrols; afterward, Piznik plans to flee and hopes Ziz can find him another job.
Tharm is a wind rider master who arranges wind rider flights. When attacked, he calls for help and summons an enraged wyvern.
Teloren is a hippogryph master who arranges hippogryph flights. When attacked, he calls for help and summons an enraged hippogryph.
Gatekeeper Kordurus is identified as a gatekeeper and uses combat magic when attacked.

Braug Dimspirit conducts a Test of Lore for students sent by Dorn, challenging them to study The Legacy of the Aspects and identify which Aspect became Deathwing. He lets them take their time and, after this first portion, points them to Parqual Fintallas for a further question.
Krond is a butcher in Stonetalon Mountains and offers his goods for sale.
Brother Ravenoak is a humanoid found in Stonetalon Mountains.
Sentinel Amarassan is a named sentinel and a combatant. This humanoid casts spells when it is attacked and when it gains a target.
Sorrow Wing is a powerful beast. Its behavior includes casting spells at two different health ranges, making it a distinct and formidable encounter.
Sister Riven is a named humanoid combatant. She casts several combat spells and an additional spell when she gains a target.
Foreman Rigger is a named humanoid combatant. He casts a spell on gaining a target and another during combat.
Taskmaster Whipfang is a named humanoid combatant. It casts a spell within a particular health range.
Pridewing Soarer is a beast.
The Chimaera Matriarch is a chimaera in the Charred Vale, described as mad with pain and despair. A galvanized horn from her is required as proof in a helm-making task.
A Stonetalon grunt found in Stonetalon Mountains.

Innkeeper Jayka offers the everyday services of an inn, including a place to rest and goods to browse. Her welcome presents the inn as a refuge for battle-weary travelers and invites them to share stories by the fire. She frames life in these new lands as a shared effort, where rest and companionship support the struggle to make a home.

Rynthariel the Keymaster is named in a Horde account as the leader of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak and a dryad who sent a scroll through a messenger. That account portrays her as an opposing presence and calls for her death, reflecting the Horde's perspective rather than Rynthariel's own words or motives.
Borand is a bowyer who offers goods for sale, including ammunition.
Gereck is a stable master who helps travelers stable pets and recover lost companions.
Hgarth is an enchanting trainer who invites visitors to seek his knowledge.
Darn Talongrip recruits for the Horde’s new Ashenvale front at Zoram Strand and directs prospective recruits to Kadrak, who is leading that campaign from the watch tower in the northern Barrens.

Kaya Flathoof has been rescued from captivity and is eager to escape before her captors discover she is free. She asks for an escort to Camp Aparaje, where she knows the way, and worries that her father, Makaba, will be desperate to learn she is safe. During the journey she warns of an ambush.

Grundig Darkcloud is a Grimtotem leader whose personal band of brutes is described as especially dangerous. Makaba identifies him as the one who led the brutal attack on his village and asks for his death in return for gratitude.

Maggran Earthbinder is a veteran Tauren protector assigned by Cairne to Sun Rock Retreat, where age and countless battles have left him hardened and in need of its gentle winds and warm sun. He watches the Bloodfuries' growing threat in Stonetalon and calls for their numbers and leader to be brought down. He also arranges reserve relief for Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift so Grish can visit his family.

Mor'rogal is a Tauren shaman investigating danger beneath Stonetalon. Resonite samples lead him to identify traces of Earthen magic and suspect a threat tied to the kobolds' mining. He enchants the crystals to weaken the slumbering Goggeroc, then urges the hero carrying them to awaken and defeat it before Stonetalon is lost. He also warns travelers that the region's caves are perilous, though they may tempt those seeking adventure and riches.

Tsunaman serves the Tribunal of the Tides in its long war against fire elementals. He asks for help gathering Incendrites from the elementals in Charred Vale and reports the effort as a victory to his water-spirit brethren. He also directs those seeking aid to Je’neu Sancrea at Zoram’gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

Tammra works to restore Stonetalon’s damaged land through the Earthmother’s blessings. She imbues Gaea seeds with shamanistic power and sends them to the scarred Charred Vale, where planting them can resist corruption and help life return. She sees this restoration as a long process, with the land’s recovery eventually bringing peace to Stonetalon.
Grimtotem Ruffians belong to the clan Makaba Flathoof blames for devastating the village. Makaba seeks revenge against the ruffians and mercenaries.

A Grimtotem mercenary among the raiders who attacked Makaba Flathoof’s village. Makaba names mercenaries among those she wants killed in revenge, marking this fighter as part of the force she blames for the assault.

A Grimtotem brute associated with the personal band of Grundig Darkcloud, whom Makaba Flathoof identifies as the leader of the attack on her village. She asks for Grundig and six brutes to be killed; this brute is one of the force she names.
A Grimtotem sorcerer who answers an attack with spellcasting, serving as a magical combatant among the clan’s forces.
Gorehoof the Black is a named Grimtotem combatant distinguished by a personal epithet. Gorehoof uses a spell in battle.
A Gogger Rock Keeper who guards a candle and panics when threatened, demanding that it not be taken and pleading not to be killed.
A Gogger Geomancer who guards a candle and panics when threatened, demanding that it not be taken and pleading not to be killed.
Gogger Stonepounder guards a candle, warning others not to take it. His brief, fearful cries plead for his life and announce that he is running away.
Besseleth is a dangerous spider whose webbed lair is in Sishir Canyon, where she and her eight-legged offspring have claimed the canyon. Maggran Earthbinder has placed a bounty on her.
Kulwia is a Trade Supplies merchant who offers goods to travelers.
Bloodfury Ripper is a humanoid combatant whose attacks include Rend. It can become enraged when badly hurt.

Xen'Zilla is a troll of Malaka'Jin who describes Stonetalon as vital to the community's hunting livelihood. Xen'Zilla seeks help against spiders raiding camps at night and stealing their game, and expresses caution about walking in the mountains after dark.

Innkeeper Faralia tends an inn where travelers can rest, make it their home, and browse goods. Her welcome invites weary guests to rest beneath her roof and asks Elune to guide their dreams, giving it a gentle devotional note.

The Stonetalon Flame Keeper tends the Midsummer flame in the Stonetalon Mountains for the Horde festival. The keeper welcomes visitors and urges Horde characters to honor festival fires in Horde-settled lands. Their speech also frames Alliance fires as targets for desecration, reflecting the festival’s factional rivalry. The associated celebration recognizes the Stonetalon flame.

place_records.text: You are in Stonetalon Mountains, contested land in Kalimdor where both the Alliance and the Horde hold settlements. The Horde keeps Sun Rock Retreat, the Alliance keeps Stonetalon Peak, and Windshear Crag belongs to neither side. Bloodfury harpies, pridewing wyverns and basilisks roam the mountains, and Venture Company goblins log and dig at Windshear Crag.

You are in Sun Rock Retreat, a Horde settlement in the Stonetalon Mountains. Its inn and flight master serve travelers, and Maggran Earthbinder, a veteran Tauren protector, watches the Bloodfuries' growing threat from here. Mor'rogal, a Tauren shaman, studies the danger beneath the mountains, and Tsunaman of the Tribunal of the Tides wages war on the fire elementals of the Charred Vale.

You are in Windshear Crag, a Venture Company mining site in the Stonetalon Mountains that neither side holds. Venture Co. loggers, diggers and operators work its mines and lumber mill. Piznik, a demoted miner, secretly gathers information for Ziz Fizziks, a gnome engineer expelled from the company.

You are in Cragpool Lake, a Venture Company works site in the Stonetalon Mountains that neither side holds. Venture Co. engineers, machine smiths and builders work beside the lake under Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, who watches over the entire site from high above the lake near a water wheel. Nizzik, a Venture armor salesman, sells armor and repairs equipment.

You are in Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains, where a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Pridewing wyverns and soarers, blackened basilisks, raging cliff stormers and deepmoss venomspitters are found around its shores. Antlered coursers charge when attacked.

You are in the Charred Vale, a scorched valley in the Stonetalon Mountains that the Venture Company's machines set afire. Bloodfury harpies and windcallers hold its ground, and scorched basilisks lurk nearby. Fire elementals and corrupted treants still threaten the land.

You are in Stonetalon Peak, an Alliance settlement in the Stonetalon Mountains. Keeper Albagorm, a protector of the forest spirits, is alarmed by the ruin of the Charred Vale and the Bloodfury harpies blocking efforts to restore it. Teloren, a hippogryph master, arranges flights from here. Sap beasts, twilight runners and fey dragons roam the slopes nearby.

You are in the Talon Den, a place in the Stonetalon Mountains where Alliance druids and dryads are found. Gatekeeper Kordurus guards it with combat magic, and Rynthariel the Keymaster, a dryad, is said to lead it according to a Horde account. Twilight runners and sap beasts roam its approaches.

You are in Greatwood Vale, in the Stonetalon Mountains, where Grimtotem mercenaries, ruffians, brutes and sorcerers range the valley. Cliff stormers roam among them. An Alliance prisoner of Jin'Zil is held here.
You are in Blackwolf River, in the Stonetalon Mountains, where Venture Co. loggers, deforesters and operators are at work. A Venture Co. foreman rigger is among the goblins there.

You are in Webwinder Path, a path in the Stonetalon Mountains where Alliance people work. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, designs explosives and distractions, and Kaela Shadowspear, a Sentinel from Ashenvale, works with him. Deepmoss creepers, venomspitters and cliff stormers lurk here.

You are in the Talondeep Path in the Stonetalon Mountains, where Horde people are found. Braug Dimspirit questions students sent by Dorn about The Legacy of the Aspects, and then points them on to Parqual Fintallas. Deepmoss webspinners and young pridewings are found here.

You are in Grimtotem Post, a post in the Stonetalon Mountains where Grimtotem brutes and sorcerers roam, with cliff stormers and Grundig Darkcloud nearby. Kaya Flathoof, a Horde woman rescued from captivity, is eager to escape before her captors discover she is free. She worries her father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to learn she is safe.

You are in Malaka'jin, a Horde troll camp in Stonetalon Mountains, where the trolls live off the mountain hunting and a butcher and a vendor serve them. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is here with his plans for three captured elves, and Xen'Zilla warns that spiders raid the camps at night to steal their game. Darn Talongrip recruits here for the Horde's new Ashenvale front.
You are in Boulderslide Ravine, a ravine in Stonetalon Mountains. Gogger rock keepers, geomancers and stonepounders roam the ravine, along with Deepmoss creepers and cliff stormers.
You are in Sishir Canyon, a canyon in Stonetalon Mountains. Deepmoss venomspitters, creepers and webspinners infest the canyon, and the creature Besseleth prowls it too.
